text: Fuzzy brown outside: what's really inside a kiwi?
A hundred grams of the green flesh has just sixty-one calories and three grams of fibre.
Its standout is vitamin C: ninety-three milligrams, more than an orange's fifty-three.
One peeled kiwi is about sixty-nine grams: about forty-two calories,
and about seventy percent of the daily value for vitamin C. Log the grams you eat.
